name: portfolio
title: Portfolio
description: A personal site for someone who makes things. A statement on the front page, a grid of work read from the work pages' frontmatter, project pages with a facts strip, about and contact. Covers are drawn from two colours, so there is nothing to photograph before you start. No plugins.

demo.tagline: Books bound by hand in a harbour town

features: Work grid built from pages/work/*.md frontmatter
Covers drawn from each project's two colours, no images required
Project pages with a facts strip from frontmatter
System light and dark with a toggle

sampleContent.purpose: The statement and the work grid
Six sample projects; one file each

notes: A project's cover is cloth and paper colours in its frontmatter; set image: to use a photograph instead
Projects sort by year, newest first, then by weight
